comment: The sweep's fast stroke, 520 px in 30 events, and the same stroke in 120, for Pencil, Grainy Pencil, Sketch and Inked Pen, at the sweep's pressure of 0.75. Each preset paints two rows. The upper row is the stroke as this harness sends it on Linux, sparse on the left and dense on the right. The lower row is the same stroke with every injected motion followed by a motion at the same point and zero pressure, which is what Input.warp_mouse makes Windows send back as a real mouse move, and is the sweep's dashes reproduced.
